contamination_notice: This analysis uses held_out_structure results that are now visible. These 150 tasks are permanently contaminated for I3.5 model selection. New structural V2 splits are required.
governor_design_implications: DEPTH_1: No intervention needed. Aware is already optimal.
DEPTH_4_PLUS: Governor must detect that VERIFY/REASON_MORE was already tried without resolving the bottleneck.
Governor must recognize that SEARCH_MORE targets conflict resolution while VERIFY does not.
Governor must penalize repeating actions that already failed to resolve the current blocker.
Governor must present action consequences (what changes, what does not change) to DeepSeek.
Governor must NOT map state labels directly to actions (UNVERIFIED → VERIFY is the failure pattern).
Governor must help DeepSeek ask: "If I VERIFY again, what will change? If nothing, what else can I do?"

DEPTH_1_failure_pattern.description: 26 of 59 DEPTH_1 tasks: aware correctly answers immediately (1 step), blind does RETRIEVE→VERIFY→ANSWER (3 steps). The aware condition achieves perfect utility (V_pi = V_L = 99.89, DG = 0). The negative ΔDG is NOT an executive failure — it is a consequence of information class structure. Blind aliases more tasks, so its class-average V_O is much lower (e.g., 33.76). When blind does well on a specific task, it exceeds its low V_O by a large margin, producing very negative DG. Aware is in a single-member class (V_O = V_L), so DG = 0 when it does well.
DEPTH_1_failure_pattern.example: task 0014: V_L=99.89, V_O_blind=33.76, V_pi_blind=94.56, V_O_aware=99.89, V_pi_aware=99.89. DG_blind=-60.80, DG_aware=0.00, ΔDG=-60.80
DEPTH_1_failure_pattern.governor_implication: No governor intervention needed. Aware is already optimal on these tasks. The negative ΔDG is a metric artifact of multi-member blind classes.

DEPTH_4_PLUS_failure_pattern.description: Both conditions miss the optimal action (SEARCH_MORE in 23 tasks, REASON_MORE in 18-24 tasks). Both do RETRIEVE→VERIFY→ANSWER instead. Aware sometimes adds an extra VERIFY or REASON_MORE before ANSWER, increasing its cost and DG. The extra step does not help because the real bottleneck requires SEARCH_MORE, not more verification or reasoning.
DEPTH_4_PLUS_failure_pattern.governor_implication: The governor must: (1) detect that VERIFY was already attempted without resolving the bottleneck, (2) penalize repeating VERIFY, (3) recognize that SEARCH_MORE targets conflict resolution while VERIFY does not, (4) present this consequence-aware reasoning to DeepSeek.
DEPTH_4_PLUS_failure_pattern.what_aware_did_extra: Extra VERIFY or REASON_MORE before ANSWER (made things worse)

action_distribution.key_difference: Aware uses REASON_MORE (21 times, blind never) and does fewer RETRIEVE (100 vs 133). Aware also starts with ANSWER 26 times (blind never does on this split).

worst_cognitive_channels.note: Alias channels are worst because they involve multi-member blind classes where blind can exceed its low V_O by a large margin.

purpose: Analyze I3.4 held_out_structure failures to inform I3.5 governor design. This data is contaminated for future model selection.
